data.situation:
In the learning workshop, Lin and Maya put two instruction cards beside a timer. One showed a route through the centre; the other gave the same route in words. Their assignment was to propose a way of comparing the cards. Before recruiting anyone, the tutor asked them to inspect the wording and explain the procedure. The draft report called the volunteers experimental subjects, while the invitation used participants. Each person would need to understand the activity and give consent before taking part. Maya removed a sentence that promised the map would be better: that was the question they wanted to investigate. Lin added a place for questions and a clear account of what would be recorded. The tutor then handed them two scatter plots labelled demonstration data. They could practise describing relationships without pretending that their own proposed study had already produced results. Workshop demonstration
Plot A pairs practice time with completed items and illustrates a positive correlation. Plot B pairs practice time with completion time and illustrates an inverse correlation: higher values of one variable tend to accompany lower values of the other. Here, inverse means a negative association; it does not establish an exact reciprocal formula. These constructed examples teach description, not results from the proposed comparison. To ask whether the instruction format causes a difference, the group must design a suitable comparison and consider other influences. Maya: If practice time correlates with the number of completed items, can we say the extra practice caused the difference?
Tutor: The plot shows an association. You need more than that to explain the cause.
Lin: Then our invitation should describe the activity and ask for consent, rather than promise an improvement.
Tutor: Yes. Bring both cards back after you have checked their wording. The report and the invitation have different audiences, but they should describe the same procedure.

readingBlocks.zh: 学习工作坊里，林和玛雅把两张说明卡放在计时器旁。一张显示穿过社区中心的路线，另一张用文字说明同一条路线。她们的任务是提出比较两种说明的方法。招募志愿者之前，导师请她们先检查措辞，解释活动步骤。报告草稿称志愿者为experimental subjects，邀请函则用participants。每个人参加前都需要理解活动并表示同意。玛雅删去了承诺地图一定更好的句子，因为这正是她们想调查的问题。林增加了提问的位置，并说明会记录哪些信息。导师又递给她们两张标着“示范数据”的散点图，让她们练习描述关系，而不假装拟议研究已经产生了结果。

readingBlocks.en:
Workshop demonstration
Plot A pairs practice time with completed items and illustrates a positive correlation. Plot B pairs practice time with completion time and illustrates an inverse correlation: higher values of one variable tend to accompany lower values of the other. Here, inverse means a negative association; it does not establish an exact reciprocal formula. These constructed examples teach description, not results from the proposed comparison. To ask whether the instruction format causes a difference, the group must design a suitable comparison and consider other influences.
readingBlocks.zh:
工作坊示范
图A把练习时间与完成题数配对，示范正相关。图B把练习时间与完成所需时间配对，示范负相关：一个变量较高时，另一个往往较低。这里的inverse指负向关联，没有确定严格的反比例公式。构造的示例用来练习描述，不是拟议比较得出的结果。要询问说明形式是否造成差异，小组必须设计合适的比较，并考虑其他影响。

Maya: If practice time correlates with the number of completed items, can we say the extra practice caused the difference?
Tutor: The plot shows an association. You need more than that to explain the cause.
Lin: Then our invitation should describe the activity and ask for consent, rather than promise an improvement.
Tutor: Yes. Bring both cards back after you have checked their wording. The report and the invitation have different audiences, but they should describe the same procedure.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：练习时间与完成题数相关，就能说多练习造成了这个差异吗？
导师：图显示的是关联。解释原因，需要更多依据。
林：那邀请函应该说明活动并征求同意，不应该承诺一定进步。
导师：对。核对完措辞后，把两张卡再带回来。报告与邀请函面向不同读者，但应该说明同一个步骤。

glossary.zh: 实验对象；参加研究的人
glossary.note: 可数人物短语；复数experimental subjects。邀请参与者时常用participants。
glossary.example: The draft report called the volunteers experimental subjects.
glossary.exampleZh: 报告草稿称志愿者为实验对象。

glossary.note: 名词 give consent to/for + 活动，或 consent to + 名词/-ing。
glossary.example: Each person would need to understand the activity and give consent before taking part.
glossary.exampleZh: 每个人参加前都需要理解活动并表示同意。

glossary.note: 名词搭配positive correlation：两个变量往往同方向变化。
glossary.example: Plot A illustrates a positive correlation.

externalEvidence.definition: a correlation in which large values of one variable are associated with large values of the other and small with small; the correlation coefficient is between 0 and +1

glossary.note: 本段inverse correlation指负相关，也常写negative correlation。
glossary.example: Plot B illustrates an inverse correlation.

glossary.note: correlate with + 变量或结果；本句描述关联，不单靠关系断言某一方造成另一方。
glossary.example: Practice time correlates with the score.

externalEvidence.label: Cambridge Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Entry gives correlate (something) with something; inflected correlates/correlated with are grammatical.

glossary.note: 及物动词 inspect + 物件或文件；本例仔细查看说明内容，不是一般的快速浏览。
glossary.example: The tutor asked them to inspect the wording and explain the procedure.
glossary.exampleZh: 导师请她们检查措辞，解释活动步骤。

retrievalPrompts.function: Two instruction cards on the desk
retrievalPrompts.cue: Invite volunteers to compare the two instruction cards. Explain the procedure, describe their role and ask for consent without promising a result.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 为两种说明卡写一条邀请，说明志愿者身份、活动步骤与征求同意，不承诺结果。
acceptableAnswers: We are inviting participants to compare two instruction cards. The report will describe them as experimental subjects. We will explain the procedure and ask for consent before the activity.

retrievalPrompts.function: Two instruction cards on the desk
retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the directions of the two demonstration scatter plots. Keep the description separate from a causal explanation.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 向同伴描述两张示范散点图的方向，不用它们证明原因。
acceptableAnswers: Plot A illustrates a positive correlation. Plot B illustrates an inverse correlation, meaning a negative association here. Neither plot establishes what causes the relationship.

retrievalPrompts.function: Two instruction cards on the desk
retrievalPrompts.cue: Revise a draft that treats correlation as causation, and say what the group should check next.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 修改一段把相关写成因果的草稿，并说明下一步要核对什么。
acceptableAnswers: Practice time may correlate with the score, but the plot alone does not establish a cause. We should inspect the instructions and design a suitable comparison before making a stronger claim.

transferPrompt.function: Two instruction cards on the desk
transferPrompt.cue: A campus survey finds a relationship between self-reported reading time and scores. Offer the teacher an accurate result statement and a follow-up question.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 一份校园问卷发现自报阅读时间与分数相关。给老师提出一句准确的结果描述和一个后续问题。
acceptableAnswers: Self-reported reading time correlates with the score in these responses. This is a positive correlation, but it does not show that reading time alone caused the difference. What other influences should the comparison consider?
